newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-GIANTS SIGN TROUBLED TACKLE, PAPER REPORTS.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-GIANTS SIGN TROUBLED TACKLE, PAPER REPORTS.

text.p: The New York Giants have signed troubled defensive tackle Christian Peter, who has been arrested for sexual assualt and is a defendant on a rape charge, the Newark Star Ledger reported on Monday.

Peter, originally a fifth-round draft pick of the New England Patriots out of the University of Nebraska, signed a three-year contract and will make the rookie minimum of $131,000 in 1997, the Ledger said.
At Nebraska, Peter was arrested for urinating in public and third-degree sexual assault. He is also a defendant in a civil trial in which a female student at Nebraska alleged Peter raped her twice.
The Patriots released Peter less than a week after the draft following protests of the selection.
The Giants' management first approached Peter in November of last season, bypassing former coach Dan Reeves.
